verdict.rationale: API-to-UI parity is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents that everything doable in the dashboard can also be done through the API. The docs only describe product capabilities (payments, Platforms, issuing, spend controls) without stating how they are accessed, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. An llms.txt file exists, but it says nothing about API coverage of UI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
